digest.component_or_area: inbound fetcher / projects store / apply inbound records
propositions: The inbound fetcher currently processes only a single configured project via one JQL pair and single enrichment pass, silently dropping parent/comment/issuelink data for all other projects in the store mapping.
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project or associated repos, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset.

The fetcher must fan out the active/done JQL pair and all three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink maps) once per configured project, merging results into a shared deduplicated snapshot while keeping per-project query truncation ceilings independent.
The source project and default repos for inbound creates must be derived from the jira key prefix and the projects mapping, and stamped at the CREATE write site in apply_inbound_records.py.
Single-project (unseeded-mapping) behavior must remain byte-identical to the pre-change implementation, issuing an identical query pair and single enrichment pass.
